detections.csv.notes: Merged catalog across templates (SelectFinal rule; the python engine works on absolute times across segments, the native engine per segment). time_s is relative to the segment's SAC reference. depth_km is in the depth reference of the input templates table (dataset.json depth_offset_km removed; 0 for hand-built datasets); depth_model_km is below the velocity-model datum. Location is the best grid node of the detecting template; magnitude is template magnitude + median log10 peak-amplitude ratio (relative, biased high at low SNR); self_detection = CC 1.0 (the template itself).

files.template_detections.csv: Every per-template detection before the merge (segment, template_id, origin_time_utc, time_s, latitude, longitude, depth_km, depth_model_km, magnitude, cc, nmad).
files.jobs.csv: One row per (segment, template): status success|failed|skipped, reason, n_rows, n_detections, grid_nodes, runtime_s, returncode.
files.jobs/<segment>/<template_id>/: INPUT.in, EventCase.out, native.log (command line + native stderr), job.json; native stack/CC files when output_mode > 0.
files.merge/: Allevents_<segment> and Allevents_<segment>.final when merge.engine = native.
files.progress.jsonl: One line per finished job, appended as jobs complete (also across --resume runs).
files.config.json: Effective parameters after defaults and overrides.

failure: Dataset validation errors, a missing binary or any failed native job (non-zero exit, exit 3 = candidate-buffer overflow, or no EventCase.out) give status=failed and a non-zero process exit; outputs of the successful jobs are still written. Existing outputs are rejected unless --overwrite or --resume is given.
